environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but with Confluent Cloud managed Kafka cluster configured with a custom Server Plugin interceptor implementing token-bucket rate limiting per producer.id (max 3 messages/minute to 'events.commands' topic with 429-equivalent ProduceResponse error code THROTTLING_QUOTA_EXCEEDED returned before message reaches partition log). Additionally, the Kafka cluster has a Schema Registry enforcement policy requiring all messages on 'events.commands' to pass Avro schema validation where the 'token' field has a maxLength constraint of 512 bytes and must match pattern '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$' - however the schema validation runs AFTER the rate limit check. The interceptor quota is configured at the broker level with quota.producer.default=180 bytes/sec with a 1-second window burst allowance.
